info.title: ACA Locale API
info.description:
Technical API documentation for ACA Locale.

ACA Locale is an AI-powered localization management platform.

This specification is generated automatically from the NestJS backend.

completeScan.description: Indicates that the payload contains the complete Shopify result set for this resource type. When true, stale local resources are tombstoned so historical translation jobs remain auditable.

resourceTypes.description: Shopify resource types to include in the translation job.

maxItems.description: Maximum number of translation fields to include in this job.

approvedValue.description: Optional manually edited translation. If omitted, the generated translatedValue is approved as-is.

note.example: Terminology adjusted for the Italian storefront.

note.description: Reason why the generated translation was rejected.
note.example: Terminology is not suitable for the Italian market.

selectable.description: Whether ACA Locale considers this model suitable for text translation/review.

primary.description: Whether this is the primary Shopify language.

published.description: Whether this language is published on Shopify.
